name: 79107 · Amarillo, TX
findings: ZIP 79107 (Amarillo) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79107 (Amarillo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79107 (Amarillo) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).
